comments.body:
This is a list of ornaments that give + 5 to this:

Calceolarias with White Urn on Table
Passion Flowers Vase on Table
Aerides Urn on Table
Cup/Table of Socrates
The Venus de Milo
Jue
Knossos Palace
Mona Lisa
The Virgin of the Rocks
The View of Toledo
Dream Catcher

It would be too extensive to list every single ornament that gives a + to this, so ill link to the Japanese wiki If you wish to find out the rest for yourself:
gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Apartment%2FOrnaments

Only thing you need to know is each rank gives [roughly] 10% extra boost time on your active skill. As with other ornament effects, this wont stack with its EX counterpart Increase skill effect duration (only the highest rank will count). Not sure about in game items that give skill effect extension such as Breath of Fortitude since it runs on a different mechanic... will test that out later.
